import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Select relevant columns for visualization
sleep_health_reduced = sleep_health[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'BMI Category', 'Heart Rate']]

# Create a jointplot with histograms
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
g = sns.jointplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', data=sleep_health_reduced, kind='reg')
g.ax_marg_x.set_title('Sleep Duration')
g.ax_marg_y.set_title('Quality of Sleep')
g.fig.suptitle('Relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep')

# Create a barplot of Physical Activity Level vs BMI Category
g = sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Physical Activity Level', data=sleep_health_reduced)
g.set_title('Physical Activity Level by BMI Category')
g.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
g.set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level')

# Create a boxplot of Heart Rate vs Stress Level
g = sns.boxplot(x='Stress Level', y='Heart Rate', data=sleep_health_reduced)
g.set_title('Heart Rate by Stress Level')
g.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
g.set_ylabel('Heart Rate')

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
